slides.title: 📅 Next Month — Know Your Finances Before the Month Begins
slides.caption:
💰 See Expected Income — Know how much money you expect to receive next month and where it will come from.
💸 See Upcoming Payables — View your loans, EMIs, subscriptions, utilities, insurance, credit cards and other scheduled payments.
🏦 Know Your Account Position — See which bank accounts money is expected to come into and go out from.
📈 Include Savings & Investments — See planned savings, investments and financial-goal contributions alongside your regular commitments.
🔮 See Your Projected Month-End Position — Understand your expected income → payments → savings → investments → remaining balance before the month even starts.

✨ Don’t wait for next month to happen — know what your financial month could look like before it begins.

modules.name: Complete Financial Picture
modules.desc: A start-of-month briefing — what is coming in, what is going out, and exactly how much is safe to spend.
